linkedin.linkBehaviorNote: Links are clickable in the post body. They do not reduce character count but LinkedIn may suppress reach for posts with external links. Consider commenting the link as a first comment to protect reach.
linkedin.toneGuidance: Professional, insight-driven, generous with expertise. Avoid corporate jargon. Write like a thoughtful peer, not a press release.
linkedin.optimalLength: 300–1,200 characters for highest engagement; up to 3,000 for deep-dive posts.
linkedin.structureGuidance: Hook → Insight or short story → Actionable takeaway → Closing question or soft CTA

hashtagRules.styleNote: Mix broad (#HRTech) and niche (#PhilippinePayroll) hashtags. Can be moved to first comment to keep captions clean.

instagram.linkBehaviorNote: Instagram does not allow clickable links in captions. Always direct readers to 'link in bio'. Use a link-in-bio tool (e.g. Linktree) to manage multiple destinations.
instagram.toneGuidance: Human, warm, visually led. The hook must land within the first 125 characters — that's all readers see before 'more'. Use emoji sparingly and purposefully.
instagram.optimalLength: Hook within 125 characters; body up to 300 characters for captions; hashtags appended or in first comment.
instagram.structureGuidance: Scroll-stopping hook (125 chars max) → Value or story → Call to action → Hashtag block

hashtagRules.styleNote: Hashtags add limited discovery value on Facebook; use only the most relevant 2–3.

facebook.linkBehaviorNote: Paste the link in the post body. Facebook will generate a link preview automatically. You can delete the raw URL after the preview loads.
facebook.toneGuidance: Community-oriented, conversational, shareable. Pose questions that invite comments. Avoid hard-sell language — Facebook's algorithm deprioritises overtly promotional posts.
facebook.optimalLength: 40–80 characters for highest engagement; up to 500 characters for storytelling posts; link posts perform best with a short intro.
facebook.structureGuidance: Question or relatable statement → Context or story → Invite engagement (comment, share, tag someone)

hashtagRules.styleNote: Inline hashtags read more naturally. Never use more than 2 — it looks spammy and harms reach.

x.linkBehaviorNote: Links are included in the 280-character count and display as shortened t.co URLs (approximately 23 characters each). Account for this when writing copy.
x.toneGuidance: Sharp, punchy, opinionated. Every word earns its place. Take a clear stance — neutral observations get ignored. Threads allow depth; single tweets demand compression.
x.optimalLength: 100–240 characters for single tweets. Leave room for a link (23 chars) and one hashtag if needed.
x.structureGuidance: Unexpected angle or contrarian take → Proof point or contrast → Hard stop or minimal CTA
